core.headline: New three-bedroom semi-detached house, Kings Hill
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house (The Larch) in Kings Hill, West Malling, with completion expected spring 2027. The property includes an air source heat pump with underfloor heating to the ground floor, an EV charging point, two allocated parking spaces and a 10-year NHBC warranty.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). On the first floor, the principal bedroom measures 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") and has an en-suite, plus two further bedrooms and a family bathroom.

Outside, there is a turfed rear garden with a patio, and two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away.

Fixed Price £410,000 for the freehold. A reservation fee of £1,500 is payable, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026. Estate charge £295 per year. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage. Heating by air source heat pump; underfloor heating downstairs, radiators upstairs. FTTP broadband available. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known. The final EPC will be issued on completion. No onward chain.
